models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.why: Meta's 816B open-weight MoE, tuned with Apple so it runs through MLX on a pair of 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios (about 1TB of unified memory) with no cloud calls.

engines.hardware: 4x Mac Studio M5 Ultra (unified memory, Thunderbolt-linked)
engines.quant: 816B MoE NVFP4 open weights across four Apple Silicon machines over Thunderbolt; Apple reports 16-37 tok/s depending on the number of Studios

engines.hardware: 4x Mac Studio M5 Ultra, 512GB each (about 1TB unified memory)
engines.quant: Meta and Apple tuned the 816B model for Apple's MLX framework; Apple Machine Learning Research reports about 25 tok/s on two Studios with tensor parallelism and about 37 on four

engines.hardware: 2x Mac Studio M5 Ultra, 512GB each, tensor parallelism
engines.quant: Apple's published benchmark at an 8,192-token context; the compressed NVFP4 version occupies about 493GB for the model before working memory
